subject: Blank lines between R code and R output

messages.author: e1c0d70b0dc3a0f6
messages.subject: Blank lines between R code and R output
parts:
I prefer to use paragraphs that are "blocky" -- i.e., no indent of the
first sentence and then increased separation between paragraphs to
distinguish the paragraphs. Thus, in my LaTeX preamble I have set the
paragraph indention to 0 and increased the separation between
paragraphs with

\parindent = 0.0in
\parskip = 0.125in

It appears that these settings -- in particular the \parskip setting
-- then causes an increased separation between the R code in a chunk
and the resultant R output from that chunk. In other words, without
the \parskip as defined above there appears to be one blank line
between the R code and the R output, but with the \parskip as defined
above there are two blank lines between the R code and the R output.

Is there a hook or some other setting that I can create or use in
knitr that will allow me to keep the "blocky" look of my paragraphs
(i.e., use the parskip setting above) but maintain the single blank
line between R code and R output for a chunk?

Thanks in advance for any help. I also apologize in advance if this
should be a LaTeX question.
